title.zh: 三星与Solana合作，三星钱包用户将可使用Solana上的USDC进行跨境汇款
title.en: 三星与Solana合作，三星钱包用户将可使用Solana上的USDC进行跨境汇款

current_state.zh: Samsung has partnered with Solana to bring Solana-based USDC stablecoin payments to its US Samsung Wallet users across 82 million Galaxy devices, enabling cross-border remittances starting in the final week of October.
current_state.en: Samsung has partnered with Solana to bring Solana-based USDC stablecoin payments to its US Samsung Wallet users across 82 million Galaxy devices, enabling cross-border remittances starting in the final week of October.
